name: Huangjin de Nizhuan
source:
Umin*ko no Naku K*ro ni characters in an A*e Attorney-style courtroom battle game! Based on the early Golden Fr*gments story arc. A murder has happened on the closed island of Rokkenjima. The player's job is to sort out truth from lies as Battler Ushir*miya. Investigate with your partner Ange, collect clues, cross-examine Erika F*rudo as a witness and reveal the culprit. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE122472.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
A*e律师风格的法庭战斗游戏中的Umin*ko no Naku K*ro ni角色！基于早期的《金色碎片》故事线。封闭的六轩岛上发生了一起谋杀案。玩家的任务是扮演战斗者Ushir*miya，从谎言中找出真相。与你的搭档安格一起调查，收集线索，盘问埃里卡·弗鲁多作为证人并揭露罪魁祸首。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE122472.html]DL站点[/url]]
